name: P11A E2 follow-up: playoff bias, short-schedule reliability
status: Fixed before any follow-up analysis was run. It does not change PROTOCOL.json, the original E2 results, the P11A specification, or any threshold. Every correction here is a research candidate, not an approved method.
inputs: The original E2 records (results/e2_records_<season>.json) and populations (cache/population). The same leakage rules as PROTOCOL.json. 2027 never used.

F1_bias_decomposition.F1a_distributions: Per event: mean qualification vs mean playoff alliance points (no_foul and components). Per playoff alliance: AS1_joint residual (actual - pred).
F1_bias_decomposition.F1b_by_event: Event-mean AS1_joint residual (no_foul): distribution, share of events > 0, median, 10% trimmed mean, by season, event type, week and size. Influence: bias after removing the 5% of events with the largest absolute mean residual.
F1_bias_decomposition.F1c_within_qualification_trend: Per event and component, refit AS1_joint (same REML method) on the first two-thirds of qualification rows by time. Predict (i) the last third of qualification rows and (ii) the playoff rows. The mean residual of (i) measures late-qualification drift; (ii) is compared with the full-qualification playoff residual.
F1_bias_decomposition.F1d_strength: Playoff residual by the alliance's predicted-strength tercile among the event's playoff alliances, and held-out late-qualification residual by predicted-strength tercile (a regression-to-the-mean check of the shrinkage).
F1_bias_decomposition.F1e_round: Playoff residual by comp_level (sf, f) and by the order of the alliance's playoff appearances (1st, 2nd, 3rd+).
F1_bias_decomposition.F1f_components_and_data: Bias by component and season (from the original records), and with vs without fouls (total vs no_foul). The exclusions are as logged; no excluded row is reintroduced.

forms.C1_multiplicative: pred' = m * pred, with m = sum(actual) / sum(pred) over the training rows; sd' = k * sd, with k = RMS((actual - m*pred) / sd) over the training rows
forms.C2_z_shift: pred' = pred + c * sd, with c = mean((actual - pred) / sd) over the training rows; sd' = k * sd, with k = RMS((actual - pred') / sd) over the training rows

F2_correction_candidates.model: AS1_joint, no_foul, from the original E2 records (no refitting)

designs.W_within_season: Per season: training = events whose end_date is strictly before the season's median event start_date; test = events starting on or after that date. Parameters are fitted per season on its training events only
designs.X_cross_season: Training = all 2024 and 2025 events; test = all 2026 events (both forms are scale-free)

evaluation_on_test_only: paired MAE difference vs uncorrected, event-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (1000 resamples, seed 20261106)
F2_correction_candidates.rule: Both forms are reported for both designs. Nothing is selected after seeing test results, and no correction is applied to the original E2 results

F3_short_schedule.schedules: The same 24 events as the original simulations (seed 20261105 sampling)

variants.V1_reml_plugin: The current method: sigma^2 and tau^2 from REML, plugged in
variants.V2_oracle: The true sigma^2 and tau^2 (isolates hyperparameter estimation)
variants.V3_sigma_known: The true sigma^2, with tau^2 from REML conditional on it
variants.V4_grid_integrated: Hyperparameters integrated: a 15 x 15 grid over log(sigma^2/var(y)) and log(tau^2/var(y)) in [-7, 1]; weights proportional to exp(-negll_REML/2) (flat prior on the logs); posterior = the weighted mixture

diagnostics: a data-only collapse flag: REML sigma-hat^2 / var(y) < 0.05
per-robot coverage 50/80/95 and width per variant and cap

criteria_check.measure: Under V1 and V4: the share of robots passing all of {n >= 4, max|corr| <= 0.5, partners >= 12, w_eff >= 0.4}, and the stricter {n >= 6, max|corr| <= 0.4, partners >= 12, w_eff >= 0.5}, plus the coverage of passing and failing robots, by cap; also with the collapse flag added

runtime: F1/F2: one task (estimated < 15 minutes). F3: one task per sigma/tau (estimated < 15 minutes each). Each has --budget-minutes (max 45) and reports partial results if it stops.
